summary: Air-date lane only. Ep 51's stored 2005-01-08 is CORRECT; the regression is caused by ep 50, whose stored 2005-12-04 is a YEAR corruption of 2004-12-04. 2nd GIG (our rows 27-52) was a pay-per-view Perfect Choice run that aired TWO EPISODES PER MONTH — ja-WP: 「2004年1月から2005年1月まで月2話ずつパーフェクト・チョイス (PPV) にて放送」 — so 49+50 share 2004-12-04 and 51+52 share 2005-01-08. 2005-12-04 is eleven months after the series ended. One repair, no true deviation.

repairs.why: en-WP List of Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex episodes: overall ep 50 / 2nd GIG ep 24 'IN: Aerial Bombing of Dejima – NUCLEAR POWER' = 2004-12-04, paired with ep 49 on the same date (as 45/46, 47/48 and 51/52 are). ja-WP 攻殻機動隊 S.A.C. 2nd GIG: the Perfect Choice run was 2004年1月 – 2005年1月, 月2話ずつ, which makes 2005-12-04 impossible and fixes the pairing structure.

structure.notes: 52 rows = S.A.C. season 1 (1-26) + 2nd GIG (27-52); row N - 26 = the 2nd GIG episode number, verified at row 49 = 2nd GIG 23 'The Day the Bridge Falls – MARTIAL LAW'.

flags_for_sean: Not a deviation but worth knowing: 2nd GIG's PPV first run aired in monthly PAIRS, so rows 45/46, 47/48, 49/50 and 51/52 legitimately carry IDENTICAL dates. The G54 order gate must treat equal consecutive dates as fine for this series. ja-WP's 各話リスト for 2nd GIG carries no 放送日 column, so the exact per-episode dates come from en-WP with ja-WP supplying the run window and the two-per-month structure.
